keyPoints.en: After the London Agreement, Tunku announced the date at Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka (20 Feb 1956).
keyPoints.bm: Selepas Perjanjian London, Tunku mengumumkan tarikh di Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka (20 Feb 1956).

keyPoints.en: Melaka was symbolic: the old Sultanate fell to the Portuguese in 1511.
keyPoints.bm: Melaka simbolik: Kesultanan lama jatuh ke tangan Portugis pada 1511.

keyPoints.en: At midnight on 30/31 August 1957, the Union Jack was lowered and the new flag raised.
keyPoints.bm: Pada tengah malam 30/31 Ogos 1957, Union Jack diturunkan dan bendera baharu dinaikkan.

keyPoints.en: 31 August 1957, Stadium Merdeka: Tunku read the Proclamation.
keyPoints.bm: 31 Ogos 1957, Stadium Merdeka: Tunku membaca Pemasyhuran.

keyPoints.en: Duke of Gloucester represented Queen Elizabeth II.
keyPoints.bm: Duke of Gloucester mewakili Ratu Elizabeth II.

keyPoints.en: Tunku became the first Prime Minister; Tuanku Abdul Rahman the first Agong.
keyPoints.bm: Tunku menjadi Perdana Menteri pertama; Tuanku Abdul Rahman Agong pertama.

keyPoints.en: Symbols: Jalur Gemilang, Negaraku, Jata Negara, Bunga Raya.
keyPoints.bm: Lambang: Jalur Gemilang, Negaraku, Jata Negara, Bunga Raya.

keyPoints.en: Independence = sovereignty: our own government, laws, foreign policy.
keyPoints.bm: Kemerdekaan = kedaulatan: kerajaan, undang-undang dan dasar luar sendiri.

keyPoints.en: Fill independence by studying, practising unity and obeying the law.
keyPoints.bm: Isi kemerdekaan dengan belajar, mengamalkan perpaduan dan mematuhi undang-undang.

tip.en: KBAT questions often ask "as a student, what can you do?" — give practical actions.
tip.bm: Soalan KBAT kerap bertanya "sebagai pelajar, apa yang boleh anda lakukan?" — beri tindakan praktikal.
